textIssues: The transcription does not preserve the table's column structure. The prompt ends with the headers Ⓐ, Ⓑ and Ⓒ on separate lines. The choices have no consistent separator between columns: choice 1 has no spaces at all (「空気中の鉛の濃度１年以内ごとに１回３年」), while choices 2, 4 and 5 have a space only before the retention period and choice 3 has a space only before 「３年」. The official image is a three-column table (Ⓐ 対象 / Ⓑ 頻度 / Ⓒ 保存期間). Each choice should separate the three values with the same delimiter, or label them as Ⓐ, Ⓑ and Ⓒ, so readers can tell which value belongs to which column. The wording and numbers themselves match the official image for all choices 1–5, and there is no image-only information because the whole table can be written as text, so figures: [] is fine.
reasonIssues: Choices 3 and 4: the reasons say that being listed as an organic solvent in 施行令別表第6の2 is why 有機則第28条 applies. That link is incomplete. Under 有機則第28条第1項, the measurement duty covers only organic solvent work involving substances in 別表第6の2 items 1 to 47 (Type 1 and Type 2 organic solvents), and it excludes work covered by 第3条第1項. Type 3 organic solvents (items 48 onward) are also in 別表第6の2 but have no measurement duty. The reasons should say explicitly that 二硫化炭素 is item 38 and メチルエチルケトン is item 44, both within items 1 to 47. The evidence context already contains 「令別表第六の二第一号から第四十七号までに掲げる有機溶剤に係る有機溶剤業務」.
